change_summary: The notice's title names the tracked paper, Green roofs and urban cooling, and the article has been retracted. The retraction was made because of image manipulation in the supplementary figures and because the temperature data could not be verified. The paper's abstract reports that green roofs lowered surface temperature by 4 C in three cities, and this headline result rests on the temperature data that could not be verified, so it can't be relied on.
